item.title: Blackduck API
item.description:
⚠️ Deprecated — removed in DefectDojo 3.5.0.

The BlackDuck API pull parser, and the Tool Configuration setup described below, are deprecated as of 3.2.0 and will be removed in 3.5.0 (November 2026). See the 3.2 upgrade notes.
